reason: Version one had already been evaluated and omitted required workload classes. Preserve its registration and results. This amendment uses a new seed, expanded telemetry and separately reported scores.
price_basis: Locked public snapshot applied to a simulated calendar; never represented as a historical invoice

forecast.monthly_interval: empirical past rolling 28-day aggregate errors, finite-sample conformal quantile; report actual coverage

detector.selection: smallest threshold meeting development non-incident false-alarm budget; boundary result is a diagnostic failure, not silently expanded

recommendations.grading: re-run identical exogenous demand with each action; estimate only observed telemetry; evaluator alone reads counterfactuals
recommendations.combine: report single actions separately; total recovery from one joint rerun, never sum overlapping savings

commitment.rates: only source-backed reserved or savings-plan offers; no simulated discount substitute

hypotheses: usage allocation versus even allocation absolute difference from capacity Shapley
selected forecast versus seasonal naive daily absolute error
evaluation.claim_rule: report intervals, exact paired cluster sign-flip p-values and BH adjustment, including negative or inconclusive outcomes
